propositions: Negative caplog assertions pass vacuously when zero records are captured, reporting success despite verifying nothing.
Logger propagation disabled via setLevel(WARNING) on the shared rebar logger persists process-globally and prevents subsequent caplog assertions from capturing records.
The pytest caplog handler attaches only to non-propagating loggers present at __enter__ and cannot rescue INFO-level records dropped at the originating logger when level is raised to WARNING.

An autouse fixture that snapshots and restores logger propagate flag and level state at test boundaries fails loudly at the source when propagation is disabled and contains level mutations to prevent cascade onto innocent tests.
Five negative caplog assertions in the test suite were verified reachable and non-void through instrumentation recording propagate state and record count across a full default-selection run.
